title: Sheafification does not change stalks (presheaves of abelian groups on a topological space)
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $x\in X$, and $\mathcal P$ a presheaf of abelian groups on $X$ (on the site of open subsets of $X$), with sheafification $\theta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Stalks are the colimits over the open neighbourhoods of $x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then the homomorphism $\theta_x:\mathcal P_x\to\mathcal P^\#_x$, $s_x\mapsto\theta_U(s)_x$ ($s\in\mathcal P(U)$, $x\in U$), is an isomorphism of abelian groups.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 007Z (lemma-stalk-sheafification: F_x = F^#_x for presheaves of sets, with proof) and Lemma 0085 (lemma-sheafify-abelian-presheaf: the sheafification of an abelian presheaf is the sheaf of sets F^# with its unique abelian structure making F -> F^# additive), Section 6.18 (Tag 0083)
